actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository is a custom Gymnasium environment for training quadruped locomotion with reinforcement learning in the MuJoCo simulator, set up for the Unitree Go1 robot
The repository provides two MJCF models for the Go1: one tuned for position control with a proportional controller and one that directly takes torque values
The environment imports MujocoEnv from gymnasium.envs.mujoco
The class Go1MujocoEnv subclasses that MujocoEnv
The Go1MujocoEnv constructor defaults ctrl_type to 'torque' and builds ./unitree_go1/scene_{ctrl_type}.xml, so its default model is unitree_go1/scene_torque.xml
The environment performs an action every 10 frames and its comment states dt 0.002 s, so one action covers 0.02 s (50 Hz)
The environment limits an episode to 15.0 s
The desired velocity is vx 0.5 m/s, vy 0 and wz 0 rad/s
An episode is healthy while the trunk height is between 0.22 and 0.65 m
The healthy roll and pitch ranges are +-10 degrees
The action is 12 torque values
The scene root is '<mujoco model="go1 scene">' and it includes go1_torque.xml
The robot model declares '<compiler angle="radian" meshdir="assets" autolimits="true"/>', so its joint ranges are radians and its meshes are resolved from assets/
The model selects an elliptic friction cone with impratio 100
The global default sets a motor with ctrllimited true and ctrlrange -1.0 to 1.0
The robot trunk is a body at 0 0 0.445 with a free joint and mass 5.204 kg
The joint default classes give the abduction joints range -0.863 to 0.863, the hip joints -0.686 to 4.501 and the knee joints -2.818 to -0.888 rad
The actuator block has 12 <motor> elements, one per leg joint; the hip and thigh motors state gear 23 and the calf motors gear 35
The home keyframe states qpos '0 0 0.30 1 0 0 0 0 0.9 -1.8 0 0.9 -1.8 0 0.9 -1.8 0 0.9 -1.8' and ctrl all zeros
The scene adds a plane geom named floor with a checker groundplane material
The MJCF description is a simplified robot description of the Go1 derived from the publicly available Unitree URDF description
The model package requires MuJoCo 2.2.2 or later and is released under a BSD-3-Clause License

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge's cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults (mj_resetData plus mj_forward) and accepts a seed input only for the class contract, so no seed selects a different state; this package's fake is a placeholder integrator and was not compared with MuJoCo

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the torque scene and its include for the 12 motors, the -1.0 to 1.0 ctrlrange, the free base and 12 hinge joints and the 2 ms step, but integrates a placeholder torque response and resolves no mesh, texture, contact, constraint, gravity, inertia or sensor

MuJoCo was not installed and cannot be installed where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the sim path (a backend name backends does not list, which imports the real mujoco module) was not run

the upstream Go1MujocoEnv wraps the scene in gymnasium.envs.mujoco.MujocoEnv with frame_skip=10, a 15 s episode limit, a reset to the home keyframe with 0.1 noise and a 50 Hz action rate; this driver loads the scene directly through the MuJoCo bridge and exposes data.ctrl and the integration state instead

the torque model commands the motors through gear 23 (hip and thigh) or 35 (calf); the bridge writes data.ctrl and the fake applies a placeholder torque scale, so actuator dynamics, the gearbox and the 1:34 motor gearing are not modelled

snapshot and restore use the bridge's fallback state (time, qpos, qvel, act, ctrl) because the fake implements no mj_getState/mj_setState; the scene has no act, mocap or integration plugin state beyond that
no rendering, viewer, joystick or training loop is modelled; the package is a local MuJoCo world, not the upstream reinforcement-learning environment or a physical Go1

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
